verdict.rationale: Orb's own docs describe a real-time webhooks system that calls an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place. That is a first-party, registrable outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single summary statement, though, so the depth of the capability is thinly documented. Missing for 10: catalog of subscribable event types, signature verification/security details, delivery retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Orb provides a powerful, real-time webhooks system that can issue calls to an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place.
